title: Balboa Park Electric Scooter Tour with Pictures
includes: Drinks and sunscreen which we recommend you bring (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for travelers with current of past injuries that might be aggravated by hoping on and off scooters
Not Recommended for people who cannot ride a bicycle
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join me on a journey through one of San Diego's most iconic places. Since this park is large, we will be touring the major sites with the wind in our hair on electric scooters. No walking required ;)

The first stop will be the beautiful botanical building and lily pond where we will pause for some pictures. Next, we will briefly cruise to the entrance to the San Diego Zoo before heading to the Spanish Village Arts Center. We will then scoot to the Morton Bay Fig Tree. It's then time to ride down the iconic El Prado passing fountains & museums along the way. After a quick stop, we will head past the International cottages on our way to the air and space museum. We will wrap up at the Spreckels Organ Pavilion before heading back to where we started.

Photos of your adventure are included!

If you want to see Balboa park in an efficient & unique way with a local guide, then this is the tour for you!

(Tips are not required but are always appreciated :)
